title: Multi-step equations
status: draft: written by Claude, waiting for owner review

hints.alg.multi-step.both-sides: Get all the x's on one side first: subtract the smaller x term from both sides. Then it's a two-step equation.
hints.alg.multi-step.distribute: Multiply the number outside the parentheses by EVERY term inside. Then combine like terms and solve.
hints.alg.multi-step: Distribute, get the x's on one side, get the numbers on the other, then divide. Check by putting your answer back in.

misconceptionMessages.alg.ms-move-sign: To move 2x off the right side, subtract 2x from BOTH sides. On the left that takes 2x away; it doesn't add it.
misconceptionMessages.alg.ms-move-constant: Moving a number across means doing the opposite to both sides: + 3 on the left becomes − 3 on both sides.
misconceptionMessages.alg.ms-stopped-early: Almost there: you have something like 3x = 12. Divide both sides by the number in front of x to finish.
misconceptionMessages.alg.ms-distribute-first: The number outside multiplies every term inside: 3(x + 4) = 3x + 12, not 3x + 4.
misconceptionMessages.alg.ms-distribute-sign: Watch the signs when you distribute: −2 times −5 is +10, so −2(x − 5) = −2x + 10.

sections.title: x on both sides
sections.objective: Solve equations with x on both sides, like 5x + 3 = 2x + 15.
explain: Subtract the smaller x term from both sides, so the x's are on one side only.
Then undo the number and divide, like a two-step equation. Check in the original equation.

sections.title: Distribute first
explain: Multiply the number outside by every term inside the parentheses. Watch the signs.
Then combine like terms, and solve as usual.
sections.key: Clear the parentheses first: the number outside multiplies every term inside. Then solve as usual.

sections.title: Putting it together
